rows.text: Resolution S.O. 1687(E), dated New Delhi, 25 July 2012: Shri Pranab Mukherjee, having been elected President of the Republic of India, takes his seat as President of India under a salute of 21 guns.

locator.item: MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS RESOLUTION, S.O. 1687(E), first paragraph (Hindi: page 1)

rows.text: The Proclamation ordered by the same resolution notifies that Shri Pranab Mukherjee, having been elected as the President of India, has entered upon the said Office, and orders the information of the assumption of office sent to military stations, missions abroad, 63 ministries and offices and 35 State and Union Territory governments [F. No. 2/3/2012-Public].

locator.item: PROCLAMATION and ORDER, lists continuing on page 4 (Hindi: page 1)

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Election Commission's notices, the Returning Officer's declaration of the result and its Gazette publication, the programme for the ceremony of assumption of office, the oath administered by the Chief Justice, the Ministry of Home Affairs resolution and proclamation of the assumption of office, the holder's address on assumption, prospective term-expiry notices, farewells, stylings of a predecessor as former President and retrospective statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Prime Minister, the Vice-President (including any service as acting President), ministers and party offices are excluded.
